🚀 #TekWissen is HIRING! | Lead Fullstack AI Engineer

Are you an experienced Fullstack AI Engineer passionate about building next-generation AI-powered applications? Here's an exciting opportunity to work on an enterprise 
AgenticOps platform!

📌 Position: Lead Fullstack AI Engineer
📍 Location: Remote
💼 Job Type: Contract
⏳ Duration: 6 Months
🏠 Work Mode: 100% Remote
⭐ Experience: 10+ Years Overall | 3+ Years in AI/LLM-focused applications

🔹 Key Responsibilities:
✅Build real-time operator dashboards and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) control interfaces.
✅Develop dynamic network topology and multi-agent execution graph visualizations.
✅Implement real-time streaming using WebSockets, SSE and gRPC-Web.
✅Build scalable Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) services and middleware.
✅Integrate AI agent frameworks, model endpoints and automation tools.
✅Develop high-performance interfaces for enterprise AI and network operations platforms.

🔹 Mandatory Technical Skills:
✅Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS.
✅State Management: Zustand, TanStack Query.
✅Graph Visualization: React Flow, Cytoscape.js, PixiJS or D3.js.
✅Real-Time Streaming: SSE, WebSockets, chunked streaming.
✅Backend: Go, Python (FastAPI) or TypeScript.
✅Authentication: SAML/OIDC, RBAC, session management and token caching.
✅AI Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph or Vercel AI SDK.
✅Model Endpoints: NVIDIA NIMs, vLLM or Ollama.
Hands-on experience with AI/LLM-native interfaces, observability platforms or network operations tooling.

🔹 Good to Have:
✅gRPC-Web, OpenClaw and Browser-Use.
✅Local Small Language Model (SLM) deployment.
✅NVIDIA/Cisco platform integrations.
✅AI-assisted development and automated testing.

🎯 What We’re Looking For:
Excellent communication, leadership, analytical and problem-solving skills, strong systems thinking, adaptability and a passion for continuous learning.

📩 Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at:
Dipti.p@tekwissen.in

💼 Employment Type: Full-Time Contract

Design, develop, and maintain PostgreSQL databases on AWS RDS.

8–9+ years of relevant experience in database/data engineering.
Strong PostgreSQL and advanced SQL expertise.
